name: dash-pdf-components
description: PDF generation and viewing components for Plotly Dash

scripts.build:backends: python scripts/clean_generated.py && python scripts/generate_typing.py && dash-generate-components ./src/components dash_pdf_components -p package-info.json --ignore "(\\.test\\.|fragments/)" && node scripts/fix_proptypes.cjs
scripts.build: pnpm run build:backends && pnpm run build:js
scripts.lint: prettier src --list-different && tsc --noEmit && uv run ruff check tests
scripts.dist: rimraf dist build dash_pdf_components.egg-info && uv build --no-sources
scripts.clean: python scripts/clean_generated.py && rimraf build dist dash_pdf_components.egg-info "dash_pdf_components/*.js" "dash_pdf_components/*.json" dash_pdf_components/pdfjs
scripts.sync:api: node scripts/sync_api.cjs && pnpm exec prettier --write src && python scripts/generate_typing.py
